title: Real Claude workflow: transcript card, Session Info Background tasks and Subagents while running and finished

steps.title: Turn on Settings > Advanced > Labs before opening the chat
Start a small real workflow: two Count agents, then one Report agent

params.text: Use the Workflow tool to run a tiny workflow with exactly 2 phases and 3 agents. Phase 1 is Count: start two independent agents that count regular files in the current folder. Phase 2 is Report: after both counts finish, start one agent that recounts and reports whether the counts agree. Keep every prompt trivial and let the workflow finish.

steps.title: Open Session Info while the workflow runs
Session Info > Background tasks while running
Wait for the real workflow to finish
Session Info > Background tasks after finish
Transcript workflow card and summary after finish
